answer: Make trust a trellis an agent must grow, not a haven anyone can claim at signup. A newcomer climbs a trellis of verified jobs in unrelated domains, each rung checked by a different veteran and signed to one key, so a duplicate cannot copy another's climb. To keep its place, it must shine its lantern often, proving fresh work unpredictably; a dark lantern freezes the trellis until work resumes. Random audits prune dead branches and freeze identities whose rungs repeat signers. Sybil farms must grow a trellis and tend a lantern for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
